svg.title: Four-stroke gasoline engine
svg.desc: (a) Intake: the piston moves down and the intake valve opens, drawing in an air–fuel mixture. (b) Compression: with both valves closed, the piston moves up and compresses the mixture. (c) Power: a spark ignites the mixture, and the hot gas pushes the piston down with force F = PA. (d) Exhaust: the exhaust valve opens and the piston moves up, pushing out the burned gas. The crankshaft turns clockwise throughout.
